facts.fact: ARCOP's pilot completion report lists an AI assistant specialised in the public procurement code and a chatbot among the support provided to users of the APPEL platform.
facts.system: Assistant IA specialise CMP / chatbot APPEL

systems.system: APPEL chatbot and Assistant IA CMP

facts.fact: ARCOP's pilot completion report says the APPEL platform was launched officially on 14 October 2025 and runs tender publication, electronic bid submission and electronic bid opening, with 15 electronic procedures launched, 9 of them open tenders.
ARCOP reports 15 electronic procedures launched (9 open tenders, 6 in progress) and 45 procurement plans for 2025 and 35 for 2026 published through APPEL.
